milestones.title: Proposition 10 — finite identities of the 35-move certificate
milestones.milestone_description: Proposition 10 (finite part): the 35-move certificate has 616 cards, including the six base cards, and 1,837 placement terms; every card satisfies A_i ⊊ T_i, o ∈ T_i \ A_i and h_i ≤ 34; and four conditional interfaces are: card 557 with A = {(-1,0)}, |T| = 118, h = 19, T disjoint from {x ≤ -3, y ≤ -2}; card 595 with A = {(-1,0)}, |T| = 222, h = 27, T disjoint from {x = -2, y ≤ -2}; card 603 with A = {(-1,0)}, |T| = 275, h = 27, T disjoint from {x ≤ -3, y = 0}; card 615 with A = {(1,0)}, |T| = 686, h = 34, T disjoint from {(1,-1)}. Here each card (A_i, T_i, h_i) is computed from the printed certificate by the base cards and the composition recursion (required set, envelope, height). The Lean target checks these data identities only; the game-theoretic meaning of the cards (Lemma 3) is not part of it.

milestones.title: Theorem 11 — Snaky in 35 Maker moves
milestones.milestone_description: Theorem 11: there is one ordinary Maker policy on the initially empty infinite square board that completes an allowed copy of Snaky (any translate of any of the eight rotations/reflections of S = {(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1),(4,1)}) within 35 actual Maker claims against every legal Breaker play. Equivalently, after extending a won position by fresh moves if necessary, its 35th Maker set contains a target whenever the first 34 Breaker replies are legal; no 35th Breaker reply is required.
